clips.title: The story
paras: Olsen's Farthing was once a flourishing farmstead situated along the primary trade road running through Silverpine Forest. In the wake of the Third War, the fields fell into ruin and became overrun by reanimated thralls bound to the renegade necromancer Thule Ravenclaw.

Before the plague consumed Lordaeron, Olsen's Farthing was a busy agricultural homestead with direct access to Silverpine's main overland trading route. Today, its tilled fields are choked with weeds, its structures lie broken, and any memory of honest farming has been erased by Scourge necromancy. Undead thralls, bound as slaves and raiders under the command of Thule Ravenclaw, wander the barren grounds to slaughter any travelers who stray too close.
